findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 4 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 22 questions numbered 1-22; by section: 4.2.2 1, 4.2.4 1, 4.3 1, 4.4.2 2, 4.4.3 3, 4.5 2, 4.7 3, 4.8.1 2, 4.8.2 1, 4.8.3 2, 4.9.1 2, 4.10 2.

22 five-mark questions in book order: transpose of a difference, matrix polynomials, the left distributive property, minors/cofactors and expansion, determinant equations, proofs by the properties of determinants, adjoint and inverse, A(adj A) = |A|I, inverse by row operations, echelon and reduced echelon forms, rank, systems by reduced echelon form (unique and infinitely many), matrix inversion, Cramer's rule with its derivation, homogeneous systems by Gaussian elimination, reflection and coding. All matrices are the portal's own; every step was recomputed in Python (sympy, check4.py). Book corrections followed: R1 + 1.R2 in Example 11(iii), x1 = -2x3 in Example 15, (-1)^(3+2) in 4.4.2.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
